page_title: FormX.ai - Automate Data Extraction to Empower Your Business

sources.entry: FormX.ai - Automated data extraction from invoices/contracts. #free

summary.name: FormX.ai
summary.one_liner: FormX.ai is an AI document data extraction service that pulls structured JSON data from documents such as invoices and contracts, accessed through an API.
use_cases: Extracting invoice fields into structured JSON
Pulling data from contracts for review
Automating finance and accounts payable document entry
Routing and classifying incoming documents before extraction
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a three-step workflow: create an extractor (from pre-built options or a custom design), upload sample documents and define the fields to extract, then connect the FormX.ai API to import structured JSON. It says it can handle image quality checks, document classification, data normalization, and feedback loops to improve accuracy over time. It offers switching between vision and LLM models, and mixing multiple models for different document types. It mentions guardrails against hallucinations and prompt engineering, and it offers a demo on the user's own files. The page is mostly marketing and gives few technical specifics beyond these points.
notable: Pipeline covers image quality checks, document classification, normalization and feedback loops for accuracy
Lets users choose between vision and LLM models and mix models per document type
Fine-tuning of LLMs on production feedback data
Demo on your own documents, with no commitment required
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; a demo is needed to see your own files
Page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete technical details or benchmarks
